data.name: Dahlia
data.gender_notes: Dahlia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Danish word dala, meaning 'to linger', or dallare, meaning 'to wander', this name has a rich history and a beautiful meaning. Dahlia is associated with the beauty and fragility of flowers, as well as the idea of savoring and enjoying the present moment. In Christian tradition, it can also symbolize the fleeting nature of earthly life and the importance of living in the moment and cherishing every day.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the present moment and cherish the beauty of life.
data.etymology: Dahlia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flowering meadow.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dahlia total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: Dahlia is a name with a captivating origin, rooted in Danish culture. In the 1700s, the Dahlia flower was discovered and brought back to Europe from Mexico by Swedish botanist Anders Dahl hence the name Dahlia after him. This luxurious and noble flower became a symbol of wealth and status, and the name Dahlia soon followed suit.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Dahlia can evoke a deep contemplation of the passage of time and the impermanence of life. The symbolism of the flower can inspire one to appreciate the beauty of each moment and to make the most of the time given on this earth. The name Dahlia can also serve as a reminder to live fully and fully engage in every experience, knowing that all things are temporary. Ultimately, the name Dahlia invites us to embrace and savor life, even in its fleeting moments.
data.spiritual_symbolism: A Dahlia in Christian symbolism represents the delicate beauty and strength found in the faith and life of a believer. Like the bloom's radiant color and robust structure, we too can bloom in the grace of God, enduring life's trials and radiating His love.

name_in_real_life.story: Ruth Dahlia, a minister in London, United Kingdom, shares that their name Dahlia meaning "Flowering meadow" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
